comment: Part of the per-platform migration of the child corporate-owned enrollment restriction.
See child-enrollment-restriction-android.json for the migration background.
Android Enterprise (Android for Work) is the corporate-owned Android enrollment path;
personal-device enrollment stays blocked, requires a minimum OS version.
